name: magisk_module_toggle
cmd: D=/data/adb/modules/$module; [ -d "$D" ] || { echo NO_SUCH_MODULE $module; exit 1; }; if [ $state = off ]; then touch $D/disable; echo DISABLED $module; elif [ $state = on ]; then rm -f $D/disable; echo ENABLED $module; else echo STATE_MUST_BE_on_or_off; exit 1; fi; ls $D/disable 2>/dev/null && echo now=off || echo now=on
